_comment: Employer key aliases for scripts/ingest-lca.mjs. Maps a normalised key to
the key it should be merged into, so filings made under subsidiaries land
on the entity a user actually searches for.
Keys on BOTH sides must already be normalised the way normalizeEmployer()
in api/_h1b.js normalises: uppercase, punctuation to spaces, legal suffixes
(INC / LLC / CORP / USA ...) stripped. Run this to check a key:
Only alias entities that are genuinely the same employer to a job seeker.
Merging a staffing vendor into its client would overstate the client's
sponsorship and is exactly the kind of error this tool exists to avoid.
